messages:
maria: Quick sync — want to run a micro PLG experiment that ties a tiny webinar + 3 onboarding nudges + 2 prompt template variants. goal: lift first-5-requests and early retention. run for 2 weeks starting next Mon.
leo: Sounds good. Can we gate the free credits to new signups only? keep churn noise down.
maria: yep — 50 starter tokens, expires 24h after signup. cohorts A/B/C based on nudge order.
samir: Nice. Metric asks: time-to-first-success, activation %, avg tokens used, 7d retention. also add a small eval for prompt quality.
tayla: I can draft webinar invite + 2 subject lines and 3 short social posts. timeline?
maria: need assets by Fri so we can launch next Mon. webinar is a 30m mini demo in week 1 as a CTA.
growth-bot: Experiment created: EX-1423 (owner: maria) — cohorts A/B/C, credit=50, templates=V1/V2.
ash: (oops typo, ignore)
leo: Eng needs a tiny param on landing: ?cohort=XXX and a cookie. quick snippet ->
```
// marketing landing
if (qs.cohort) setCookie('mkt_cohort', qs.cohort, {maxAge: 86400})
```
leo: that'll let backend map inbound leads to cohorts.
ash: (I meant ashley)
ashley: I'll update inbound routing once eng adds the cookie. rule: signup_source in [webinar, demo] => cohort=B.
samir: Also add a 5-prompt eval set to watch for quality regressions with templates (hallucination risk).
tayla: I'll include benchmark snapshot in the invite doc: baseline metrics + expected deltas. will post to the thread when ready.
leo: frontend: adding a feature flag for the 'template tour' modal. tagging @eng-frontend for rollout.
eng-frontend-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/templ-tour -> staging (2025-04-02 03:00 UTC).
maria: Support heads up: there will be credit questions. @support-team pls add a short FAQ blurb.
ashley: noted, will add FAQ + routing for support tickets with tag EX-1423.
tayla: draft share: subject lines: 1) "Build with Redwood: 50 starter tokens + live demo" 2) "Try prompts that ship — 30m mini demo" — will attach copy by Thu EOD.
samir: One more ask: record cohort assignment in analytics so we can do funnel attribution easily.
leo: analytics event -> marketing.cohort_assigned with properties {cohort, signup_source}.
maria: Perfect. last: let's create a short post-launch benchmark thread to dump results. if we hit >10% lift in activation we'll expand.
tayla: :thumbsup: I'll set calendar invite for the mini-webinar and share landing copy.
maria: Thanks team — pinned doc: <https://redwood.app/docs/EX-1423> — check it and drop any blockers here.
